ir.name: loss_diffsigmoid_advantage_penalty_clamped_repaired
ir.intuition: Clamps the advantage_gap to a safe range and ensures weight is always present, preserving the squared penalty with clamping to prevent large gradients.
ir.pseudocode:
p_w = sigmoid(lpw - lpl)
adv_gap_clamped = clamp(advantage_gap, -clip_threshold, clip_threshold)
diff = p_w - adv_gap_clamped
penalty = diff^2
clipped_penalty = clamp(penalty, 0, clip_threshold)
loss = mean(weight * clipped_penalty)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    clip_threshold = 1.0
    adv_gap_clamped = ops.clamp(advantage_gap, -clip_threshold, clip_threshold)
    p_w = ops.sigmoid(ops.sub(lpw, lpl))
    diff = ops.sub(p_w, adv_gap_clamped)
    penalty = ops.mul(diff, diff)  # squared penalty
    clipped_penalty = ops.clamp(penalty, 0.0, clip_threshold)
    loss = ops.mul(clipped_penalty, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
